name: OPGI Chlef data center and structure interconnection project
developer: OPGI de la wilaya de Chlef
notes: Tender archive records a national consultation by OPGI de la wilaya de Chlef for study/supervision of a project to create a data center and interconnect structures. Treated as a small public-sector data-center project; no capacity disclosed.

name: University of Laghouat datacenter / HPC computer room
developer: University of Laghouat / ICE Informatique et Communication d'Entreprises
notes: ICE company presentation lists University of Laghouat among references for a 'PROJET D'AMENAGEMENT SALLE INFORMATIQUE (DATACENTER)' involving a computer room for HPC and IBM Linux HPC deployment. Exact commissioning date and capacity not disclosed.

name: University Batna-2 data center and high-performance computing unit
notes: APS-based local report states Batna-2 launched construction of a data center in parallel with the university's 2016 creation to host servers, storage, protection equipment, and the HPC unit; the high-performance computing unit entered full operation in 2022.

name: Djezzy Cloud Data Center, Amizour
notes: Datacenters.com lists Djezzy Cloud Data Center at Afra, 06, Amizour, Bejaia, Algeria, categorized as colocation. No capacity or official operator technical sheet found during this pass.

name: Second National Digital Services Data Center, Blida
developer: High Commission for Digitalization / Huawei consortium
notes: Reports on the HCN-Huawei national digital services program say the first site is in Mohammedia, Algiers, and a second national data center is to be established in Blida; ANEP/BOMOP tender text references assistance for IT and data center facilities works for the Blida national digital services data center.

name: Algeria Telecom Lakhdaria data center project
notes: DCD notes Algeria Telecom had announced plans in 2017 for a new data center near the group's existing satellite hub in Lakhdaria, Bouira; Ecofin reported the planned class-international facility in the Lakhdaria area near Algeria Telecom's satellite teleport. No later commissioning confirmation found in this pass.
